quote_inputs: home/away net EPA/play (garbage-time, kneel/spike, WP<0.05 excluded; OT retained), nflfastR cp/ep-family expected turnovers.
what_the_file_does_say: Names home_netEPA and away_netEPA inside the fair_margin equation.
Calls the input home/away net EPA/play.
Names play filters: garbage-time excluded, kneel/spike excluded, WP<0.05 excluded, OT retained.
missing_definition: Does not say how netEPA is computed from play-by-play or from an existing table.
Does not say the aggregation: per-play pool versus per-game rates; offense only versus net of opponent. The word net is a label, not a formula (no offense EPA minus EPA allowed, no opponent netting).
Does not name the EPA column or which plays are offensive versus defensive.
Names garbage-time but does not define it (no score differential, no separate WP cutoff beyond the listed WP<0.05 exclusion).
Does not state the team-week window (season-to-date, rolling, or otherwise).
decision: No netepa_pit.parquet. Definition was not invented.
